extraFacts.fact: API 598 covers the inspection and testing of valves, including shell, backseat and seat tests; API 609 covers butterfly valves (lug, wafer and double-flanged types, Category A and Category B); API 600 covers bolted-bonnet steel gate valves; API 602 covers compact steel gate, globe and check valves of small bore; API 603 covers corrosion-resistant bolted-bonnet gate valves; API 6D covers pipeline valves; API 594 covers wafer, lug and flanged check valves; API 599 covers metal plug valves; API 607 is the fire test for valves with non-metallic seats; BS 1868 covers steel check valves and BS 1873 steel globe valves; ASME B16.34 covers valve pressure-temperature ratings and ASME B16.10 covers valve face-to-face lengths; EN 10204 3.1 is the inspection certificate type for material certificates; ISO 15848 covers fugitive emissions of valves.
extraFacts.source: API 598, API 609, API 600, API 602, API 603, API 6D, API 594, API 599, API 607; BS 1868; BS 1873; ASME B16.34; ASME B16.10; EN 10204; ISO 15848 (standard titles)

faqs.q: What is the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve used for?
faqs.a: The BS 1873 cast steel globe valve is a globe valve built to BS 1873, ASME B16.34, used for steam, feedwater, bypass, drain and control duty. It is made in NPS 2" to 36" (DN50 to DN900) and ASME Class 150 to 2500, and is built to order and supplied from Dubai; see the [globe valves](/c/industrial-globe-valves).

faqs.q: How do I read the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve part numbers such as IH-PV-GLC-600-0600?
faqs.a: In the size table IH-PV-GLC-600-0600 is the 6" valve in Class 600: the number before the size is the class, and the last four digits are the size in hundredths of an inch. The table lists 71 size and class combinations.

faqs.q: What sizes and classes is the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve available in?
faqs.a: The published range for the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve is NPS 2" to 36" (DN50 to DN900), in ASME Class 150 to 2500. The size table lists 71 size and class combinations with lengths and weights, so you can check the valve against the piping layout.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve take?
faqs.a: The BS 1873 cast steel globe valve is rated ASME Class 150 to 2500. The rating falls as temperature rises, so give the design pressure and temperature of the line and we confirm the class and material.

faqs.q: What materials is the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve made in?
faqs.a: The body is available in carbon steel, alloy steel, stainless steel, duplex, with hardfaced seat and disc; plug, parabolic or needle disc. The construction is Bolted bonnet, T, Y or angle pattern, rising stem.

faqs.q: What tests and documents come with the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve?
faqs.a: Each BS 1873 cast steel globe valve has shell, backseat and seat tests to API 598, with the material certificates (EN 10204 3.1) and the pressure-test record supplied. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: How is the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve operated, and what end connections does it have?
faqs.a: The BS 1873 cast steel globe valve has RF, RTJ flanged; butt-weld ends and is operated by handwheel, gear operator or actuator. Say which operator and end connection you need, and give the pipe schedule for butt-weld ends.

faqs.q: BS 1873 cast steel globe valve: Which disc should I choose?
faqs.a: A flat or swivel disc suits on-off duty. A plug or parabolic disc gives finer control over a wider opening and resists erosion when throttling. A needle disc is for small, precise flows. Tell us the flow range and pressure drop.

faqs.q: BS 1873 cast steel globe valve: Can the flow go either way?
faqs.a: Globe valves are usually installed with the flow under the disc, so the packing sees downstream pressure when the valve is closed. On steam and high-pressure lines flow over the disc is sometimes specified; the body is marked with the direction.

faqs.q: How does the BS 1873 cast steel globe valve compare with the API 602 forged steel globe valve?
faqs.a: The BS 1873 cast steel globe valve differs from the [API 602 forged steel globe valve](/p/forged-steel-globe-valve-api-602) in construction: bolted bonnet, T, Y or angle pattern, rising stem here, forged body, T, Y or angle pattern, bolted, welded or pressure-seal bo on the other. Also, standard: BS 1873, ASME B16.34 here, API 602, ASME B16.34 on the other. This valve is for steam, feedwater, bypass, drain and control duty; the other is for drains, vents, sampling, bypass and steam lines.

faqs.a: The BS 1873 cast steel globe valve is built to order to your specification and supplied from Dubai, UAE to projects, plants and maintenance teams across the GCC, the wider Middle East and Africa. Delivery depends on size, class, material and operator; standard carbon-steel sizes move fastest.
